answer: Here is a specific defense: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. An identity earns only when its jetty recurs, its relic survives audit, and a horizon from an unlinked peer confirms it.
